title: Tokopedia Product Search Scraper
description: Scrape product search results from Tokopedia (Indonesia's largest marketplace). Extracts product name, price, discount, shop info, ratings, reviews, and more. Supports pagination, price range filters, official store filter, and location filtering.

searchTerms.title: Search Keywords
searchTerms.description: Keywords to search for on Tokopedia (e.g., 'laptop gaming', 'sepatu nike', 'handphone samsung')

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape. Each page contains up to 50 products. Max 50 pages (2500 products).

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Sort results by a specific field.

minPrice.title: Minimum Price (IDR)
minPrice.description: Filter products with price above this value (in IDR, no dots).

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price (IDR)
maxPrice.description: Filter products with price below this value (in IDR, no dots).

minRating.title: Minimum Rating
minRating.description: Only return products with rating >= this value (1-5).

officialStore.title: Official Store Only
officialStore.description: Only return products from official/brand stores.

location.title: Location
location.description: Filter by seller city (e.g., 'Jakarta', 'Surabaya', 'Kudus'). Leave empty for all locations.
